title: MegaStyle Style Transfer Framework and ComfyUI Nodes
summary: A state-of-the-art style transfer system from Tencent utilizing a SigLIP-based encoder and FLUX.1-dev architecture. It enables high-fidelity artistic style transfer onto text-to-image prompts while effectively eliminating content leakage from the reference image.
research_notes: A collaborative effort between Tencent and Tongji University; features a unique style-score computation system for evaluating artistic consistency.

evolution.summary: After its April 2026 release, the project expanded to include the MegaStyle-1.4M dataset and a specialized style encoder that significantly outperforms prior CSD models. Official ComfyUI nodes were integrated directly into the main repository shortly after launch.
